title: Reefer Cargo Services: Setting Change Records, Limits and Fees
content:
Every accepted alteration of carrying settings on a Reefer Cargo Services unit is entered on the service's charge record, whether or not a fee is due. This page defines how alterations are counted, the ceiling on them, and the fee each one carries.

## Clause

An accepted alteration is entered as one record per calendar day on which settings are altered; several instructions actioned on the same day make up a single alteration. The count of alterations on a service is the number of such records already on that service, including records entered at 0.00, before the alteration now in hand. A service takes no more alterations than the tier's maximum, so an alteration can be accepted only while that count is still below the maximum.

The fee depends on when the alteration is made. For an alteration before departure, the record is entered at 0.00 while the count is still below the tier's number of free alterations, and at the tier's pre-departure change fee once the count has reached that number. For an alteration after departure, each one is charged the tier's fee for a remote change after sailing.

## Counting and pricing table

| Existing records on the service | Timing | Within the count limit? | Amount entered |
|---|---|---|---|
| fewer than the free allowance | before departure | yes, if below the maximum | 0.00 |
| at or above the free allowance, below the maximum | before departure | yes | pre-departure change fee |
| below the maximum | after departure, remote alteration permitted | yes | remote change fee |
| equal to the maximum | any | no | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical tier)

Imagine a tier with two free alterations, a maximum of four, a pre-departure fee of 50.00 and a remote fee of 30.00, remote alteration being permitted.

- Day one: two instructions arrive and are actioned that day. They form one alteration; no records exist yet, so it is entered at 0.00.
- Day two: one record exists, which is below two, so the new alteration is entered at 0.00.
- Day three: two records exist, reaching the free allowance, so the alteration is entered at 50.00.
- After sailing, day four: three records exist, still below four, so a remote alteration is entered at 30.00.
- Day five: four records exist, equal to the maximum, so no further alteration is accepted.
